key_point: Look closely at the clouds in Mario
title: Look closely at the clouds in Mario
caption: In Super Mario Bros., the clouds and the bushes are the exact same drawing. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #supermariobros #nintendo

instagram.caption:
In Super Mario Bros., the clouds in the sky and the bushes on the ground use the same sprite.

The whole game had to fit in about 40 KB, so Nintendo recolored one drawing instead of storing two.

Millions of kids ran past them for years and never noticed. Now you will see it every time.

Did you ever notice it?
